# Brainwave Protocol Notebook (quantumbrainwaveprotocol.onrender.com)

> Independent information and ordering website for Quantum Brainwave Protocol, a digital audio program of binaural beat and isochronic tone tracks marketed for relaxation, focus and a calm mindset. Contents per the seller: three tracks (Wealth Frequency, 7 minutes; Deep Sleep Eraser, 20 minutes; Genius Focus, length not stated) and three reading extras (The 5-Minute Manifestation Journal, 101 Signs The Universe Is Listening, The Scientific User Manual). Suggested use: stereo headphones, 7 to 20 minutes a day. Price $59 one time through ClickBank; 60-day money-back guarantee requested through ClickBank.

IMPORTANT: it is a digital audio program, not a medical device or treatment, and it does not make money appear; no study of the program is known, and research on binaural beats is mixed (small to moderate effects on anxiety and mood in some studies, mixed for attention and memory, limited for sleep). Never listen while driving or operating machinery; keep volume low; ask a doctor first with a seizure disorder, hearing condition or mental health condition. Adults 18+ only. Seek emergency care for a seizure or blackout, or thoughts of self-harm.

Not the creators' website. Contains affiliate links.
